blocks.text: Karen Davila recounted facing backlash after she moderated the 2016 presidential debate, admitting it “traumatized” her and prompted her to take a break from social media. The veteran broadcast journalist spoke about this during an interview on “Beyond the Exchange with Rico Hizon,” which aired last Saturday, Oct. 24. The topic was brought up after she was asked how she deals with negative comments online. “So I think my first trauma with the comment section, and I’d like to share it was during the presidential elections of 2016, when troll farms were born,” she recalled. “So I moderated the presidential debate, […]...
